data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 contradicts SRC_001's implicit commitment to a positive mechanism (registry-size confound) by asserting that the evidence is too small and contaminated to support any transferable condition at all: SRC_001 proposes that mutation count explains the distribution, while SRC_002 claims the 3-of-26 result warrants no mechanism beyond local artefact. Refuted if the 4/4 to 6/7 consistency in ordinarily-guarded modules survives replication across a different repository, author, and week, thereby establishing a regularity that SRC_002 denies is inferable.
